data.goal: Document E065/E067 findings and decide on fresh observation direction

data.next: apply view-count measurement to non-Q&A corpora (medical, educational needs) or test cross-platform generalizability of web-search view-count proxy
data.summary: E065: improved view-count classifier with info_keywords 'who is', 'where is', 'latest news', 'news about' pushes G4 from 16/20 to 17/20 (PASS). E067: compared view-count platform patterns across 6 hobbyist SE sites (arm1) vs Stack Overflow (arm2): Arm1 has 110 unremedied rows (9.2%) with 98.2% technique-or-expertise shape and 14.3pt G4 gate pass; Arm2 has 0 unremedied rows (all answered) with G4 gate fail (0.0pt gap). Per D083, next session starts from fresh observation in new domain.
